title: Owner UI Exposure Audit — Evidence Ledger
method: Traced every owner page (src/app/(authenticated)/owner/*), the components it renders (src/components/owner/*), and the API route it calls (src/app/api/owner/*), plus grep for whether each proven module is imported anywhere under src/app. Backend/API existence alone was NOT counted as owner-visible.
ownerPages: owner/ (PriorityCommandStrip + SupervisorSummary + control-center) — actionable (tasks/complete, approvals/resolve, opportunities/decide)
owner/process-intelligence — the governed cockpit (ProcessIntelligencePanel + ProcessExecutionBridgePanel) → POST /api/owner/process-execution
owner/execution — SOP diagnosis-cycle actions (older pipeline; NOT the bridge)
owner/recovery — recovery diagnosis-cycle (older engine; NOT recovery-milestone-execution)
owner/intake — manual CSV/paste intake (actionable; no live connectors)

owner/wealth, owner/trust, owner/finance, owner/cashflow, owner/marketing, owner/operations, owner/sales, owner/strategy, owner/budget, owner/portfolio, owner/first-value, owner/onboarding — domain surfaces

provenLoopOwnerVisible.actionRoute: src/app/api/owner/process-execution/route.ts (POST, OWNER_MANAGE-gated, server-authoritative, workspace-scoped, re-derives routes → applyProcessExecutionAction)

evidenceForUnwired: grep -rln '<module>' src/app returned no matches for each; the six modules import only each other + __tests__.

noLiveAiOrExternalAction.note: Consistent with PASS 34: no live LLM write-path; process-execution route enforces owner-only material decisions and blocks unsafe external action; no auto-contact/submit/spend/discount/contract anywhere in owner UI.
